cues.zh: 我们对 Computex 2017 的报道由 Corsair One 和 Synergy 赞助播出。
cues.en: Our coverage of Computex 2017 is brought to you by the Corsair One and Synergy.

cues.zh: 你可以在视频描述里的链接中查看它们。
cues.en: You can check them out at the link in the video description.

cues.zh: 我一直对 Intel 全新的高端桌面 X299 平台 conspicuously 保持沉默
cues.en: I have been conspicuously silent about Intel's new high-end desktop X299 platform

cues.zh: 以及他们刚刚宣布搭配它的 CPU。
cues.en: and the CPU's that they just announced to go with it.

cues.zh: 这是有意的，但可能不是你想的那些原因。
cues.en: And, this was on purpose, but probably not for the reasons that you think.

cues.zh: 过去几天我一直在展场里走访，和业内的人聊天，
cues.en: I've spent the last few days walking the show floor, chatting with industry folks,

cues.zh: 总的来说就是想搞清楚
cues.en: and generally trying to wrap my head around

cues.zh: Intel 这次发布到底想干什么。
cues.en: what the actual hell it is that Intel's trying to do with this launch.

cues.zh: 不过在深入之前，先说说 X299 的基础。
cues.en: Before we get into that though, a primer on X299.

cues.zh: socket 2011-v3 已经是旧闻了，
cues.en: So, socket 2011-v3 is old news,

cues.zh: socket 2066 才是班上炙手可热的新女孩。
cues.en: socket 2066 is the hot new girl in class.

cues.zh: 新芯片组带来对“最高”7 系 Skylake 架构 Intel Core i9 处理器的支持，
cues.en: With the new chipset comes support for "up to" 7-series Skylake-based Intel Core i9 processors,

cues.zh: 我们得到“最高”四通道 DDR4 内存，运行在“最高”DDR4 2666MHz，
cues.en: we get "up to" quad channel DDR4 memory running at "up to" DDR4 2666MHz,

cues.zh: 我们得到“最高”44 条 PCI express 通道，用于大规模扩展，
cues.en: we get "up to" 44 PCI express lanes for massive expansion,

cues.zh: “最高”大幅扩展的 NVMe 和 Optane 存储能力
cues.en: "up to" greatly expanded NVMe and Optane storage capabilities

cues.zh: 以及“最高”两个首选 Turbo [Boost] Max 核心，运行在更高的睿频频率上。
cues.en: and "up to" two preferred Turbo [Boost] Max cores that run at higher boost frequencies.

cues.zh: 这个“up to”是怎么回事？
cues.en: Well, what's with all this "up to"?

cues.zh: 我待会儿说，先来看看这些主板。
cues.en: I'll get to that, first let's take a look at the boards.

cues.zh: Intel 的合作伙伴全力支持这项新技术。
cues.en: So Intel's partners have been out in full force with support for this new tech.

cues.zh: 华硕展示了大约六块基于相同基本设计的主板，
cues.en: ASUS was showing about half a dozen boards based on the same basic DNA,

cues.zh: 每块都有一些同样突出的特点。
cues.en: each with some same stand out features.

cues.zh: Rampage VII Extreme 配备双水流传感器，
cues.en: The Rampage VII Extreme includes dual water flow sensors

cues.zh: 配合这一代标配的水泵接头，
cues.en: to go with the pump headers that are standard on this generation,

cues.zh: 他们的 Deluxe 主板配备 802.11ad 多千兆无线，
cues.en: their deluxe board includes 802.11ad multi-gigabit wireless

cues.zh: 以及 OLED POST 系统监控显示屏，
cues.en: and an OLED POST-in system monitoring display,

cues.zh: 而“TOUGHMARK 1”则带有常规的额外温度传感器、
cues.en: and the 'TOUGHMARK 1' comes with the usual extra thermal sensors,

cues.zh: 加固装甲，还有一个显卡下垂支架！
cues.en: tough armour, and a freaking graphics card sag holder!

cues.zh: 技嘉的数字 RGB 接头支持可单独寻址的 LED 灯带灯效，
cues.en: GIGABYTE's Digital RGB header allows lighting effects with individual addressable LED strips,

cues.zh: 他们的“SmartFan 5”软件现在可以让风扇完全停转，
cues.en: their 'SmartFan 5' software now allows fans to be turned off outright

cues.zh: 只要系统温度允许，这对我这种“静音狂人”来说是天大的好事。
cues.en: if system temperatures allow it, a huge boom to 'silence-freaks' like me.

cues.zh: 他们在USB 3.1 10Gbps接口上可谓下足了功夫，包括
cues.en: They've gone ham on USB 3.1 10-gigabit ports including,

cues.zh: 和其他厂商一样，支持全新的Type-C前面板规范，
cues.en: like the others, support for the new type-C front panel spec,

cues.zh: 他们还展示了4块PCIe NVMe SSD组建的RAID阵列，
cues.en: and they were showing off 4 PCIe NVMe SSDs running in RAID,

cues.zh: 这本身并不算什么突破性的创举，
cues.en: which in of itself, isn't exactly groundbreaking,

cues.zh: 但它们是由CPU直连驱动，而且还能作为启动盘，这就很惊艳了。
cues.en: but that fact that they were running off of the CPU, and they were bootable, is.

cues.zh: 说到NVMe，MSI有主板原生支持多达5块M.2 SSD，
cues.en: MSI (on the subject of NVMe) has boards with native support for up to 5 M.2 SSDs,

cues.zh: 并且非常强调为它们做好散热。
cues.en: and is putting a really strong emphasis on cooling for them.

cues.zh: 和其他所有厂商一样，他们在主板颜值上也花了不少心思。
cues.en: Like everyone else, they've given a lot of thought to the aesthetics of their boards.

cues.zh: 你甚至可以根据模板3D打印配件，某些情况下还能更换散热器外壳，
cues.en: You can even 3D print accessories from templates and swap cooler covers in some cases,

cues.zh: 而且有意思的是，和其他厂商不同，他们有一颗白色或红色LED灯
cues.en: and, unlike everybody else this is interesting, they've got a white or red LED

cues.zh: 能告诉你装的是哪种CPU，
cues.en: that tells you what kind of CPU you've you've got installed,

cues.zh: 进而让你知道主板上你看到的那些功能
cues.en: and in turn then, how many of the features that you're looking at on the board

cues.zh: 究竟有多少会被真正启用！
cues.en: are actually going to be enabled!

cues.zh: 我想这正好可以给视频里精心设计的部分画上一个相当自然的句号，
cues.en: Which I guess brings us to a fairly natural conclusion to the nicely scripted part of this video,

cues.zh: 因为我手头还有些粗略的笔记，有些别的事情得先卸下来，
cues.en: because I've got some rough notes with some other stuff that I've gotta get off of my back,

cues.zh: 但要这么做的话，我觉得咱们最好还是出去溜达一圈。
cues.en: but to do that I think, it's probably better if we go for a little walk.

cues.zh: 回到我之前的那个问题……
cues.en: Going back to my earlier question...

cues.zh: 这个平台到底是什么？
cues.en: What is this platform?

cues.zh: 说实话，在我看来，Intel 自己恐怕都还没真正拿定主意。
cues.en: Quite honestly what it looks like to me is that Intel themselves can't really decide.

cues.zh: 就好像他们翻来覆去改了好几次主意，
cues.en: It's like they've changed their mind multiple times,

cues.zh: 整件事看起来就像是对
cues.en: and the whole thing just seems like this kneejerk reaction to

cues.zh: AMD 宣布最高 16 核 32 线程的“Threadripper”平台的本能反应。
cues.en: AMDs announcement of their up to 16-core 32-thread 'Threadripper' platform.

cues.zh: 然后我是说，他们做的有些事情看起来就像是
cues.en: And then I mean, some of the things they're doing look just kind of like a

cues.zh: 在拼命讨好发烧友和游戏玩家……如果他们跟我感觉差不多的话……
cues.en: half-desperate attempt to appease enthusiasts, and gamers who... if they feel anything like me where...

cues.zh: 你知道，过去十年主流一直停留在四核处理器上。
cues.en: you know, the mainstream's been stuck with quad-core processors for the last 10 years.

cues.zh: 即便是在发烧级层面，能多拿到两个核心就算走运了，而且上一回，
cues.en: And even on the enthusiast level, we're lucky to get another 2 cores, and last time around,

cues.zh: 我们甚至还得额外掏700美元，只为获得这个特权——
cues.en: we even had to pay another $700 just for the privilege

cues.zh: 在新一代“Broadwell-E”上从8核升到10核。
cues.en: of going from 8 to 10 cores with the new 'Broadwell-E' generation.

cues.zh: 说清楚点，对我个人而言，这些大多是好事。
cues.en: I mean to be clear for me personally, a lot of this stuff can only be good.

cues.zh: 我是说高核心数、可超频的水冷服务器，
cues.en: I mean high core count, overclockable water-cooled servers,

cues.zh: 那正合我胃口；简直完美！
cues.en: that's right in my wheelhouse; that's perfect!

cues.zh: 当你不用自己掏钱买硬件时……贵？没问题！
cues.en: And when you're someone who doesn't pay for hardware then... it's expensive? No problem!

cues.zh: 更别说作为硬件发烧友，我根本不用费劲
cues.en: I mean not to mention that as a hardware enthusiast, I'm not gonna be struggling

cues.zh: 去搭配正确的主板、正确的内存和正确的CPU
cues.en: to pair the correct board, and the correct memory, and the correct CPU together

cues.zh: 来确保我榨干整个平台的性能，
cues.en: to make sure that I'm getting the most out of the entire platform,

cues.zh: 因为说实话，这恰恰是当前平台最大的问题之一，
cues.en: 'cause honestly that's one of the biggest problems with the platform right now,

cues.zh: 它真的很令人困惑；Kaby Lake-X把水搅浑了，
cues.en: it's really confusing; Kaby Lake-X muddies the water

cues.zh: 这种方式对Intel来说完全说不通！
cues.en: in a way that just makes absolutely no sense for Intel to do!

cues.zh: 我是说，我在展会上跟这里的系统集成商聊过，名字我就不点了，
cues.en: I mean, I've spoken to system integrators here at the show, I'm not going to name them by name or anything,

cues.zh: 但他们直截了当地说：“我们不会支持这个。平台这方面一团糟，因为Kaby Lake-X到底算什么？”
cues.en: but they flat out said "we're not going to support this. This aspect of the platform is a mess, because what is Kaby Lake-X?"

cues.zh: 表面上看，好像他们已经把最新架构加到了这个平台上，
cues.en: Like on the surface, it sounds like they've gone ahead and they've added the latest architecture

cues.zh: 以一种，你知道，很惊艳的方式……“哇，我们一夜之间就搞出了新一代”那种感觉，
cues.en: to this platform in some, you know, amazing... "wow, we engineered a new generation overnight" kind of way,

cues.zh: 但实际上发生的是，他们把主流平台上现有的Kaby Lake处理器，
cues.en: but what actually happened was they took the existing Kaby Lake processors on the mainstream platform,

cues.zh: 就这么直接钉在了2066插槽上。
cues.en: and just, like, stapled them on to socket 2066.

cues.zh: 7740和7640跟1151插槽版本相比，唯一的区别
cues.en: the only difference between the 7740 and the 7640 compared to the socket 1151 versions

cues.zh: 就是它们的TDP标称高了20瓦，
cues.en: is that they're rated at 20 watt higher TDPs,

cues.zh: 频率高了100 MHz（0.1 GHz），而且Intel承诺它们有更好的超频能力。
cues.en: they're clocked 100 MHz (0.1 GHz) higher and Intel is promising better overclocking on them.

cues.zh: 但说到底，我会只为了这个再花一百美元买一块主板吗……
cues.en: but at the end of the day, am I going to spend another hundred dollars on a board just for that...

cues.zh: 英特尔到底为什么要阉割主板上的所有功能
cues.en: and why on earth would Intel neuter all the features on the motherboard

cues.zh: 就为了让我能把芯片跑到稍微高一点的频率？
cues.en: just for the sake of me being able to run a chip at like a little bit higher frequency?

cues.zh: 它们并没有更多的 PCI Express 通道！
cues.en: They don't have more PCI express lanes!

cues.zh: 仍然只有十六条，更让人困惑的是，它们还只支持双通道内存。
cues.en: They've still only got sixteen and, making matters even more confusing, they only run dual channel memory still.

cues.zh: 所以当你去买一块 X299 主板时，它可能有
cues.en: So when you go and you buy an X299 motherboard, it can have

cues.zh: 四到八个内存插槽，可能支持两组双通道内存，
cues.en: anywhere from four to eight memory slots on it which might support two sets of dual-channel memory,

cues.zh: 一组四通道内存，或者两组四通道内存。
cues.en: a single set of quad-channel memory, or two sets of quad-channel memory.

cues.zh: 所以如果你装的是 Kaby Lake-X CPU，有些 DIMM 插槽实际上可能用不了！
cues.en: So you might actually have DIMM slots that don't work if you install a Kaby Lake-X CPU!

cues.zh: 哦，我是说……对，这也太离谱了；我甚至忘了那部分
cues.en: Oh and I mean... right, this is crazy too; I even forgot the part how

cues.zh: X299 主板不会配备板载显卡所需的全部接口，
cues.en: X299 boards aren't going to have all the connectors for onboard graphics,

cues.zh: 所以板载显卡被熔断了，这本身倒不算什么大问题；
cues.en: so the onboard graphics are fused off, which wouldn't inherently be a huge problem;

cues.zh: 我本以为，愿意花 300 到 600 美元买主板的人
cues.en: I expect someone spending, you know, $300 to $600 on a motherboard

cues.zh: 会去买一块独立显卡，但问题在于，这样一来你甚至用不了某些功能，
cues.en: to buy a dedicated graphics card but the issue is that then you can't even use features

cues.zh: 那些你在主流平台上本来能用的功能，比如 QuickSync，
cues.en: that you would be able to on the mainstream platform like QuickSync, for example,

cues.zh: 它们依赖集成 GPU 才能工作。
cues.en: that rely on the integrated GPU in order to function.

cues.zh: Kaby Lake [X] 完全说不通。彻头彻尾。
cues.en: Kaby Lake [X] just makes no sense. At. All.

cues.zh: 好，那现在我们来聊聊那些反其道而行之的高核心数 CPU。
cues.en: Okay, so now let's talk about those reactionary high core count CPUs.

cues.zh: 再说一遍，我不是在抱怨，一颗可超频的 18 核 Extreme Edition 听起来很棒。
cues.en: Again, I'm not complaining, an 18-core Extreme Edition that's overclockable sounds great to me.

cues.zh: 但众所周知，Intel 只打算用低核心数版本的
cues.en: But everyone and their dog knows that Intel was only planning to use the low core count version

cues.zh: Xeon 处理器来打造他们的高端桌面平台。
cues.en: of their Xeon processors to create their high-end desktop platform.

cues.zh: 所以最多也就 12 核，不出所料，在展会上，
cues.en: So that was going to be up to 12 cores, and surprise surprise here at the show,

cues.zh: 他们展示的唯一芯片就是基于那一款的。
cues.en: the only chips they're showing are based on that one.

cues.zh: 所以 Intel 做的事就是，他们一看，“哎呀不好，AMD 有 Threadripper 了；”
cues.en: So what Intel did is they saw, "oh no, AMD has Threadripper;"

cues.zh: “他们发布大家真正想要的东西，让我们显得很没面子！”
cues.en: "They're making us look bad by announcing this stuff that people really want!"

cues.zh: “呃呃呃，快！发布点什么东西！虽然……”
cues.en: "Uh, uh, uh, quick! Announce something! Even though..."

cues.zh: “……你知道，我们不知道功耗会是多少，不知道频率会跑多高；”
cues.en: "...you know, we don't know how much power it's going to consume, we don't know what clock speeds it's going to run at;"

cues.zh: “我们不知道要卖多少钱；但我们必须确保发布点什么，”
cues.en: "We don't know how much we're going to charge for it; we need to make sure we're announcing something,"

cues.zh: “这样等 AMD 推出 Threadripper 时，我们不至于完全措手不及，毫无应对之力。”
cues.en: "so that when AMD launches Threadripper, we're not caught completely with our pants down, and no way to react to it."

cues.zh: 但问题就在这里；他们采取这种“观望”策略的原因，我个人不太喜欢。
cues.en: But here's the problem; they're taking this 'wait-and-see' approach for a reason that I personally don't really like.

cues.zh: 他们想先看看Threadripper会发展成什么样，再决定向消费者交付什么产品，
cues.en: They want to see what Threadripper turns into before they commit to what they're gonna deliver to the consumer,

cues.zh: 而这恰恰正是他们一开始就面临的困境所在。
cues.en: and that's exactly the problem that they're running up against in the first place here.

cues.zh: 给你们一些企业战略建议，免费奉送，Intel。
cues.en: Here's some corporate strategy advice, free of charge Intel.

cues.zh: 尽你所能打造最好的产品，以你能做到的最好价格交付，
cues.en: Build the best thing you can for the best price that you can deliver it,

cues.zh: 这样你就不会被竞争对手打个措手不及——
cues.en: and you're not going to get blindsided by a competitor

cues.zh: 对方一进场就用更低的价格交付了更好的东西！
cues.en: that walks in and delivers something way better for a lower price!

cues.zh: 所以我们有了这个非常令人困惑的平台；
cues.en: So we've got this really confusing platform;

cues.zh: 我们在高端桌面平台上有了这些中等核心数、筛选出来的Xeon，
cues.en: we've got these mid-core count harvested Xeon's on the high-end desktop platform

cues.zh: 它们将通过拥有大量PCI Express通道来做出差异化，
cues.en: that are going to be differentiated by having lots of PCI express lanes

cues.zh: 我认为这就是它们获得Core i9 designation的原因，
cues.en: which I think is what gives them the Core i9 designation,

cues.zh: 我们还会有普通芯片，其中一些仍然拥有大量PCI Express通道，最高到12核——
cues.en: we're gonna have the normal chips, some of which still have lots of PCI express lanes and go up to 12 cores--

cues.zh: 到目前为止我提到的所有产品都支持四通道内存，以及28到44条PCI Express通道。
cues.en: all of the ones I've mentioned so far support quad-channel memory and anywhere from 28 to 44 PCI express lanes.

cues.zh: 接下来是Kaby Lake-X，它只支持16条PCI Express通道，而且你听听这个；
cues.en: Then we're going to have Kaby Lake-X, which only supports 16 PCI express lanes, and get this;

cues.zh: 主板厂商必须让每一块主板都支持你能插进插槽的任何芯片。
cues.en: the motherboard manufacturers have to support any chip that you could put in the socket on every single board.

cues.zh: 你怎么能围绕16到44条PCI Express通道来设计一块主板，
cues.en: How do you build a board around 16 to 44 PCI express lanes,

cues.zh: 还要支持双通道到四通道内存，以及4到18个核心！？
cues.en: dual to quad-channel memory, and anywhere from 4 to 18 cores!?

cues.zh: 整个发布太仓促了，技嘉干脆在他们任何X299主板上都不支持Thunderbolt 3，
cues.en: The whole launch is so rushed that Gigabyte flat-out isn't supporting Thunderbolt 3 on any of their X299 boards,

cues.zh: 因为他们没时间走完认证流程，
cues.en: because they didn't have time to go through the certification process,

cues.zh: 整件事混乱得要命，不只是普通消费者，连发烧友都觉得晕。
cues.en: and the whole thing is confusing as hell to not just the general consumer, but even enthusiasts.

cues.zh: 而且，这里还有其他一些东西我也完全无法理解。
cues.en: And I mean, there's other stuff here that just makes no sense to me as well.

cues.zh: VROC，好吧？
cues.en: VROC, okay?

cues.en: So I talked about how you can have, you know, "up to", you know, better support for NVMe storage than ever before...

cues.en: So this is a really cool feature; you can actually run bootable RAID through the CPU

cues.en: rather than letting it get bottlenecked by the chipset now with NVMe devices.

cues.en: But out of the box, Intel is only supporting RAID 0, and if you wanna run RAID 1 or RAID 10,

cues.en: you need to buy a $99 physical key and plug it into the board,

cues.zh: 如果你还想在这些基础上再支持 RAID 5，
cues.en: and if you wanna support RAID 5 on top of all that other stuff,

cues.zh: 那还得再掏 300 美元！我理解他们担心
cues.en: you're gonna pay another $300! Like I get that they're worried about cannibalizing

cues.zh: 这个平台会蚕食自家 Xeon 以及服务器和高端工作站的销量，
cues.en: their Xeon sales, and their server and high-end workstation sales with this platform

cues.zh: 但这看起来简直是开倒车，
cues.en: but this seems like such a step backwards

cues.zh: 消费级产品居然要回去买 RAID 密钥，
